briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief — 2026-10-06 (SGT)

  • NAV S$10,298,651 (-0.33%); Oct 5 base restated UP overnight to 10,300,308 (+S$2,072, restatement night 8); real day move vs restated base about -0.02%, flat. The -0.33% headline still runs off a stale baseline.
  • Biggest mover: silver — spot +2.13% to about $61.71, best weekly run since February, gold-silver ratio down to about 67.5; now 30 cents under the $62 add-suspension line.
  • The one thing: the flag storm is over — watcher shrank from 7 flags to 2 and both survivors are verified stale-baseline artifacts (Xiaomi flag -7.8% vs actual -1.49%; CDL flag -7.5% vs actual -0.28%). Meanwhile the 30y Treasury closed 5.684%, about 7bp from the 5.75% capitulation arm of the defense-sleeve gate.

Flag integrity — glitch day 6, shrinking (7 to 2)

  • Xiaomi -7.8% flag: FALSE — stale baseline at Sep 25 close 25.90 (23.88/25.90 = -7.8% exactly). Actual Monday: 23.88, -1.49%.
  • CDL -7.5% flag: FALSE as a day-move — stale baseline at Sep 28 close 7.59 (7.02/7.59 = -7.51% exactly). Actual Monday: 7.02, -0.28%, held 7.00 intraday. Real story: six-session slide 8.26 to 7.02 = -15.0% since the strategic review, now stabilizing.
  • SMIC, GDX, SILJ, SLVP flags gone — watcher caught up on those names. L46.SI Yahoo 404, 18th session.

Position moves (Monday)

  • HK: HSI 24,040.34 +0.28% back above 24,000; HS Tech +0.62%; short ratio 18.54% (Tencent, Xiaomi, Alibaba most-shorted). Tencent 423.00 +0.43% (still below 425), SMIC 61.30 +1.74%, Xiaomi 23.88 -1.49%. AI chain led: Kingboard Laminates +11.9%.
  • SGX: STI 5,664.33 +0.52%. CDL 7.02 -0.28%, UOL 8.19 +0.37%, DBS 77.36 -0.18%, UOB 43.34 +1.17%, Singtel +0.47%, Sembcorp +1.55%. SGX itself flat at 22.61 — Friday's -7.16% digested on day one of the new 10-share board lots.
  • US: SPX 7,773.95 +0.66% (0.3% below record), Nasdaq record 27,477.31 +1.05%, DJI +0.18%, VIX 15.52 +1.37%. NVDA record 2nd straight session. 10y 5.31% +3bp (touched 5.35%, highest since 2002), 30y 5.684% +7bp. ISM services 54.9 but prices 74.0 hot. Oct hike odds collapsed to about 18-24%; Dec about 69%.
  • Metals: spot gold about $4,163 +0.25%; spot silver about $61.71 +2.13%; platinum +2.1%. GDX 88.09 +0.35%, SILJ 27.11 -0.44%, SLVP 34.94 -0.54% (vs Thu 34.85 — capture gap resolved, no material drop). DXY 102.10 YTD high. WTI -2.0%, Brent -1.9% at $100.32.

Insider (last 7 days)

  • Wing Tai: September filing run holds at 18, latest Sep 29; no October filings on the IR page as of Oct 6. source
  • No other substantial-shareholder/director filings found for held SGX or HK names.

Congress (window Oct 3-6)

  • No new filings — aggregator's newest disclosure date remains Friday Oct 2 (the five groups reported yesterday: RI Senate Dem sells JPM/V/ADI; WA-1 muni rotation; VA-8 munis; OH-2 AMGN/HD buys, MPC sells; LA-6 GOOG/AAPL/MSFT/NFLX buys). Nothing in held tickers. source

Trump / policy watch (24-48h)

  • Iran: Trump open to direct talks but warns on UK drones; Bessent — Operation Economic Outcast delivering, Iran loaded zero crude last month; Treasury warns banks; Semafor — Iran may inflict pain before midterms; Pezeshkian rebuffs talks.
  • Houthis hit Ras Tanura refinery (550k bpd) and Rabigh, then Houthi leader called for a truce; Saudi East-West pipeline halted then flowing; Aramco CEO — pressure until Hormuz reopens, stockpile refill 2 years.
  • Uranium/grid: US DoE announces $4.2bn to boost nuclear power in Pennsylvania and Ohio.
  • Gold: ECB's Nagel — case for further diversification into gold remains significant; Lane — second wave of energy supply shock.
  • Trade/domestic: Trump in no rush on Canada talks; red-dyed diesel plan; blames Ukraine refinery strikes and US closures for gas prices.
  • Europe fiscal stress: EUR weakest since May 2025 — French strike day Nov 5, Spain snap election Nov 29. Dollar at YTD high is the transmission line into metals and the non-SGD book.

Risk

  • Both daily.json flags verified stale-baseline artifacts; no genuine new single-day breaks. Glitch healing (7 to 2).
  • Concentration: SG property drawdown stopped accelerating (CDL -0.28%, UOL +0.37%) but CDL is -15% over six sessions with analyst targets 60-70% above price — the market-analyst gap is the risk statement on the strategic review.
  • FX: about 35% of net worth non-SGD; DXY YTD high 102.1, EUR breaking down, US-Japan intervention fresh.
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz at about $61.71 x 1.2794 = about S$140.3k vs S$56,240 loan — equity about S$84.1k, about 1.67x. A -4% silver day is about -6.7% equity; -6.7% silver is about -11% equity (trips the IBKR rule). Price is 30 cents under the $62 suspension line.
  • Rates: 30y 5.684% about 7bp from the 5.75% capitulation arm; ISM prices 74.0; FOMC minutes Wednesday.

Alpha (signals, not advice; about 62% idle cash)

  • Silver / SILJ / SLVP: the $62 line decision is now tomorrow's problem. Spot $61.71, best week since February, Western physical buying the Golden Week dip vs Deutsche Bank's oversupply call. Signal: pre-commit the rule — honor the $62 suspension as designed, or formally extend to $63 with DXY at YTD high as the stated reason. Don't improvise at the line.
  • Defense sleeve: 30y 5.684% vs the 5.75% capitulation line; Oct hike odds collapsed to about 20% yet the long end keeps selling — textbook term premium. Gate unchanged: rally-and-hold sub about 5.15%, or 30y capitulation above 5.75%. Neither met; the second is closer than ever. FOMC minutes Wednesday.
  • HK barbell (0700.HK / 1810.HK): squeeze setup into Thursday's mainland return — HSI short ratio 18.5%, AI chain leading, Xiaomi corporate still buying back, Tencent 423 just under 425. Signal: 425 reclaim on mainland volume voids the provisional break; a fade keeps tranche-2 lower entry standing.

trumpWatch.title: Iran: squeeze vs talk track
trumpWatch.detail: Trump says he is always open to direct talks with Iran but warns Iran will 'suffer greatly' if combat drones are in the UK; Bessent says Operation Economic Outcast is delivering — Iran loaded zero crude onto tankers last month; Treasury warns banks may be sanctioned for Iran business; US official (Semafor): Iran may try to inflict pain on Trump before the midterms; Pezeshkian calls negotiations pointless.

trumpWatch.title: Houthi escalation then truce call
trumpWatch.detail: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery (550k bpd) with missiles; fires at Rabigh refinery and export pipeline; Riyadh flights suspended; then Houthi leader al-Bukhaiti called for a truce. Saudi East-West pipeline reported halted then flowing normally. Aramco CEO: pressure worsens until Hormuz reopens; stockpile refill could take two years. UKMTO logged multiple tanker strikes Oct 3-4 and an IRGC turn-back.

trumpWatch.title: Uranium/grid: DoE $4.2bn nuclear push
trumpWatch.detail: US Department of Energy announced a US$4.2bln investment to boost nuclear power and help lower energy costs in Pennsylvania and Ohio — direct support for the AI-bottleneck/grid theme.

trumpWatch.title: Gold: official-sector bid endorsed
trumpWatch.detail: ECB's Nagel said the case for further diversification into gold remains significant; ECB's Lane framed the energy surge as a second wave of the supply shock. Spot gold about $4,163, silver $61.71 with its best weekly run since February.

trumpWatch.title: Trade/domestic: Canada, diesel, gas prices
trumpWatch.detail: Trump in no rush to resume Canada trade talks; expected to unveil a red-dyed diesel plan to ease use of the tax-exempt variety; said Russian refinery strikes by Ukraine and US closures are driving up gas prices.

trumpWatch.title: Europe fiscal stress — FX channel
trumpWatch.detail: EUR weakest vs USD since May 2025: French unions called a nationwide strike day for Nov 5; Spain's PM Sanchez called a snap election for Nov 29. DXY at YTD high 102.1 — the transmission line into metals and the non-SGD book.
